signature.name: Yuelu Academy
signature.detail: One of China's four great ancient academies, founded in 976, with serene courtyards and stone inscriptions. It sits at the foot of Yuelu Mountain; go early on weekdays to avoid crowds and combine with a walk up the mountain.

signature.name: Orange Isle
signature.detail: A long island in the Xiang River famous for its giant Mao Zedong sculpture and river views. Best visited at sunset; walk or take a short metro ride to the island, and note it can be very hot in summer.

signature.name: Hunan Museum
signature.detail: Home to the remarkable Mawangdui Han tomb artifacts, including a 2,000-year-old preserved body. Free entry but book online in advance; closed on Mondays.

signature.name: Yuelu Mountain
signature.detail: A lush mountain with walking trails, temples, and panoramic city views. Take the cable car up if you're short on time; wear comfortable shoes and bring water.

signature.name: Tianxin Pavilion
signature.detail: A historic pavilion on a city wall with views over Changsha. A quick, peaceful stop; go in the late afternoon for cooler weather and fewer visitors.

signature.name: Kaifu Temple
signature.detail: A active Buddhist temple with incense-filled halls and a calm atmosphere. Dress respectfully (cover shoulders and knees) and visit in the morning when it's most lively.

signature.name: Changsha IFS Tower T1
signature.detail: The city's tallest skyscraper, with a rooftop sculpture and an upscale mall below. Head to the observation deck for city views at dusk; the mall is a good spot to cool off in summer.

signature.name: Juzizhou Bridge
signature.detail: A bridge crossing the Xiang River with pedestrian walkways and views of Orange Isle. Walk across at sunset for great photos; it's a pleasant way to reach the island.

signature.name: Hunan First Normal University
signature.detail: A historic university where Mao Zedong once studied, with preserved early 20th-century buildings. Visit on a weekday when the campus is open to visitors; it's a quiet, leafy place.

food: Casual meal $5-10; street food even cheaper
